groundZero.title: 断续的救援信号
groundZero.story: 风沙散去，一架后勤机与基地重新取得联系。你可以调来工兵，也可以留下眼前的物资。
groundZero.storyEn: A logistics craft reconnects through the dust. Call engineers or retain the field supplies.

saltFlats.title: 盐壳上的旧中继
saltFlats.story: 沉积层中露出一处旧中继。让受控单位驻留接通，换取短暂施工窗口。
saltFlats.storyEn: An old relay emerges from the salt. Hold the marked ground with your controlled unit to open a construction window.

testingGrounds.title: 试验设施自检
testingGrounds.story: 旧设施完成一轮自动校准，短暂开放施工和制造调度带宽。
testingGrounds.storyEn: The old facility finishes calibration, briefly opening construction and unit-production bandwidth.

frozenForest.title: 雪下的补给箱
frozenForest.story: 飘雪露出三处散落货物。分批回收，不必为了物资离开防线太久。
frozenForest.storyEn: Drifting snow reveals three small supply drops. Recover them in short trips without abandoning the front.

biomassFacility.title: 孢子附着
biomassFacility.story: 孢子遮蔽了施工信标，调度效率短暂下降。可以投入矿物清理，或守住现有防线等待恢复。
biomassFacility.storyEn: Spores foul construction beacons. Spend basic ore to clear them or hold the current line until they recover.

taintedWoods.title: 林间巡检点
taintedWoods.story: 林间残存的线路亮起。驻留重新接通后，可短暂加快施工；不必拆掉原有产线。
taintedWoods.storyEn: A surviving forest circuit lights up. Hold its relay to accelerate construction briefly without dismantling production.

crateredBattleground.title: 坠落的工具舱
crateredBattleground.story: 陨坑边缘落下一只工具舱。有限的物资可以转给工兵，也能留在核心周转。
crateredBattleground.storyEn: A tool capsule lands by the crater. Use its limited supplies for engineers or core stock.

ruinousShores.title: 潮线遗物
ruinousShores.story: 浪花退去，岸边留下三小批货物。按标记逐处驻留回收，原有水道保持通航。
ruinousShores.storyEn: Receding spray exposes three small cargo lots. Visit their markers; the original shipping lanes stay open.

perilousHarbor.title: 港口信号重连
perilousHarbor.story: 一座岸上导航中继恢复响应。接通后开启短暂扩建窗口，舰队仍按原指令行动。
perilousHarbor.storyEn: A shore navigation relay responds again. Reconnect it for a short construction window while the fleet keeps its orders.

facility32m.title: 自动设备抢占链路
facility32m.story: 旧自动设备抢占调度链路。施工与单位制造短暂减速，供电和弹药库存不受影响。
facility32m.storyEn: Old automation competes for the dispatch link. Construction and unit fabrication briefly slow; power and ammunition remain intact.

windsweptIslands.title: 风中的登陆信标
windsweptIslands.story: 一处近岸信标恢复供电。受控单位驻留接通后，可以抓住短暂的施工窗口。
windsweptIslands.storyEn: A nearby landing beacon comes alive. Hold it with your controlled unit to secure a brief building window.

stainedMountains.title: 山坡散落的矿袋
stainedMountains.story: 尘土褪去，山坡上出现三处零散物资。逐次回收，每次只需短暂停留。
stainedMountains.storyEn: Settling dust reveals three small supply caches. Recover them one at a time with short stops.

extractionOutpost.title: 采掘调度空档
extractionOutpost.story: 旧采掘调度器释放出空余带宽，短时间利于补线和制造援军。
extractionOutpost.storyEn: The extraction scheduler frees bandwidth, briefly helping construction and reinforcement production.

coastline.title: 沿岸工兵联络
coastline.story: 沿岸维护队接通了通讯。调配少量矿物可借来工兵，也可选择接收现货。
coastline.storyEn: A coastal maintenance team reconnects. Commit a little ore for engineers or take field stock.

weatheredChannels.title: 水道测绘中继
weatheredChannels.story: 测绘中继重新发出信号。驻留接通可换取一段施工加速，原有水路不被截断。
weatheredChannels.storyEn: A channel-survey relay transmits again. Hold it for a construction boost without closing the waterways.

navalFortress.title: 前线维修调度
navalFortress.story: 前线工具舱抵达。是在交战中抽调工兵，还是保留库存补充后续防线，由你决定。
navalFortress.storyEn: A frontline tool capsule arrives. Choose temporary engineers or retain supplies for the next defensive line.

frontier.title: 边境旧货标记
frontier.story: 风卷开地表浮尘，三处旧货标记显露。短途回收能补充基础物资。
frontier.storyEn: Wind reveals three old cargo markers. Short recovery trips replenish basic supplies.

fungalPass.title: 菌林中的断线端子
fungalPass.story: 菌林里一段旧线路亮起。驻留完成重接后，短暂加快施工组织。
fungalPass.storyEn: An old circuit lights up in the fungal passage. Hold its terminal to restore a brief construction advantage.

infestedCanyons.title: 峡谷通讯杂波
infestedCanyons.story: 峡谷中的杂波干扰施工和制造调度。可支付少量矿物重校链路，也可等待短时干扰过去。
infestedCanyons.storyEn: Canyon noise disrupts building and fabrication dispatch. Recalibrate with a little ore or wait out the brief interference.

atolls.title: 礁岛漂流物
atolls.story: 海风送来三小批漂流货物。标记落在基地附近可站立的已知地面，不要求派出船只冒险。
atolls.storyEn: Sea wind brings three small cargo lots onto known ground near the base. No risky naval expedition is required.

sunkenPier.title: 码头装卸窗口
sunkenPier.story: 旧码头的调度器完成清理，短暂提高施工及单位制造效率。
sunkenPier.storyEn: The old pier scheduler clears its queue, briefly speeding construction and unit fabrication.

mycelialBastion.title: 林间补给联络
mycelialBastion.story: 补给队从菌林边缘取得联系。工兵和现货只能择一，物资只在本次任务有效。
mycelialBastion.storyEn: A supply team reconnects at the fungal edge. Choose engineers or stock; neither benefit persists beyond this mission.

overgrowth.title: 被藤蔓包围的端子
overgrowth.story: 藤蔓间一处旧端子开始闪烁。驻留接通线路，换取短暂扩建机会。
overgrowth.storyEn: An old terminal flickers among the vines. Hold it to reconnect a short building window.

tarFields.title: 油雾中的信号衰减
tarFields.story: 油雾干扰了调度信号，施工与制造短暂减速。现有炮塔、发电机与运输线照常工作。
tarFields.storyEn: Oil haze weakens dispatch signals. Building and fabrication briefly slow while turrets, generators and transport continue.

impact0078.title: 雪尘中的工具残箱
impact0078.story: 雪尘后露出三处工具残箱。趁风雪尚未重新覆盖它们，逐个驻留回收。
impact0078.storyEn: Snow dust reveals three tool caches. Recover them with short holds before drifting snow covers them again.

desolateRift.title: 断层边缘的补给舱
desolateRift.story: 一只补给舱滑入基地附近。调来工兵能加快临时补墙，留下现货则利于后续周转。
desolateRift.storyEn: A supply capsule slides near the base. Engineers help rapid construction; stock supports later logistics.

nuclearComplex.title: 旧控制网串扰
nuclearComplex.story: 旧控制网出现短时串扰，只影响施工与单位制造调度。可投入基础矿物提前恢复。
nuclearComplex.storyEn: The legacy control network suffers brief crosstalk affecting building and unit fabrication. Basic ore can restore it early.

littoralShipyard.title: 船坞调度松绑
littoralShipyard.story: 船坞调度器腾出一段带宽。利用短窗口补建前线或加快已有单位制造。
littoralShipyard.storyEn: The shipyard scheduler frees a short window for construction and existing unit fabrication.

planetaryTerminal.title: 终端地勤请求
planetaryTerminal.story: 终端地勤建立临时联络。选择短时工兵支援，或把这一批现货留给前线。
planetaryTerminal.storyEn: Terminal ground services make temporary contact. Choose a short engineer deployment or retain their field stock.

onset.title: 初次地勤联络
onset.story: 本地地勤接通通讯。基地刚刚起步，是借来短时工兵，还是先保留现货，由你决定。
onset.storyEn: Local ground services establish contact. The base is young: choose temporary engineers or retain their field stock.

aegis.title: 庇护地的散落货物
aegis.story: 地面浮尘下出现三处散落货物。控制单位逐处驻留回收，注意保持生产运行。
aegis.storyEn: Settling dust reveals three supply caches. Visit them with your controlled unit while production continues.

lake.title: 湖岸热传感端子
lake.story: 湖岸旧端子恢复微光。靠近驻留接通后，可短暂加快施工，不改变原有热源和水路。
lake.storyEn: A lakeside terminal glows again. Hold it for a short building window without changing heat sources or waterways.

intersect.title: 交汇处调度空档
intersect.story: 交汇处的自动调度器暂时释放带宽。施工和单位制造短暂提速，原有攻防阶段照常推进。
intersect.storyEn: The junction scheduler briefly frees bandwidth for building and unit fabrication; original battle phases continue.

atlas.title: 山脉测绘链路
atlas.story: 基地附近一处测绘端子亮起。驻留把链路接回来，就能调来短时施工支援。
atlas.storyEn: A survey terminal near the base lights up. Hold it to reconnect the link and call temporary construction support.

split.title: 岔路地勤选择
split.story: 地勤队只够承担一项任务：短时施工支援，或卸下基础物资后离开。
split.storyEn: Ground services can perform one job: temporary construction support or unloading basic supplies.

basin.title: 盆地制造排程窗口
basin.story: 盆地旧排程器清理了拥塞。已有施工和单位制造短暂提速，原材料消耗保持原样。
basin.storyEn: The basin scheduler clears its congestion. Building and fabrication briefly speed up with unchanged material costs.

marsh.title: 湿地边缘的货标
marsh.story: 浮尘落定，三处货标显露在附近可站立地面。逐次回收即可，不需要踏入危险液体。
marsh.storyEn: Dust settles to reveal three nearby markers on solid ground. Recover them without entering hazardous liquid.

peaks.title: 峰间旧测站
peaks.story: 峰间旧测站重新响应。让受控单位驻留接通，换取短暂的扩建机会。
peaks.storyEn: An old peak survey station responds. Hold its marker with your controlled unit for a short construction window.

ravine.title: 溪谷维护联络
ravine.story: 维护队抵达谷口联络点。用少量基础矿物调来工兵，或接收一批现货。
ravine.storyEn: A maintenance team contacts the ravine base. Commit a little basic ore for engineers or accept field stock.

caldera-erekir.title: 热流引发的通讯漂移
caldera-erekir.story: 热流使调度信号短暂漂移。只有施工和单位制造减速，发电与运输仍正常。
caldera-erekir.storyEn: Thermal currents briefly disrupt dispatch. Construction and fabrication slow while power and transport remain normal.

stronghold.title: 要塞排程间隙
stronghold.story: 要塞旧调度网终于腾出一段空闲。抓住短暂提速的机会，补建阵地或赶制下一批部队。
stronghold.storyEn: A gap opens in the old stronghold dispatch network. Use the brief acceleration to fortify positions or fabricate the next squad.

crevice.title: 裂隙浮尘下的货箱
crevice.story: 裂隙浮尘散去，三处小货箱在基地附近显露。回收时间有限，但放弃不会扣星。
crevice.storyEn: Crevice dust reveals three small nearby caches. Recovery is time limited, but skipping them never deducts stars.

siege.title: 围攻中的维护抉择
siege.story: 维护小组终于接通。是短时加快施工，还是补一点库存，为下一轮推进作准备，由你决定。
siege.storyEn: A maintenance crew reconnects. Choose a short construction boost or a little stock for the next advance.

crossroads.title: 路口协调端子
crossroads.story: 路口的旧协调端子重新亮起。派受控单位驻留接通，给各条战线争取一段施工窗口。
crossroads.storyEn: An old crossroads terminal lights up. Hold it with your controlled unit to open a construction window for the different fronts.

karst.title: 岩层电磁杂波
karst.story: 岩层反射引发短时调度杂波。可投入基础矿物重校，也可依靠现有阵地等待恢复。
karst.storyEn: Reflections from the rock cause brief dispatch interference. Recalibrate with ore or hold the current positions until recovery.

origin.title: 终局维护窗口
origin.story: 残存的调度网重新连通。短暂的高效窗口里，可以补建前线，也可以赶制下一支突击队。
origin.storyEn: The surviving dispatch network reconnects. Use its brief efficient window to reinforce the front or fabricate another assault squad.
